youtube.title: They mocked the 13 curse and lost 🏙️ #Shorts
youtube.description: By the 1880s the fear of thirteen was so common in New York that a group of men decided to mock it. They formed the Thirteen Club: thirteen men at one table, walking under ladders, spilling salt, and eating lobster salad moulded into coffins. Did they win? No. Skyscrapers were rising, and nobody wanted to rent on the unluckiest floor, so builders simply changed the number. Full episode on the channel. #Shorts #history #newyork #superstition #thehiddenwhy

instagram.caption: In 1880s New York, thirteen men formed a club to prove the fear of thirteen was nonsense. They ate lobster salad shaped like coffins. They lost anyway, because skyscrapers were rising and nobody would rent the unluckiest floor. So builders changed the number. #thehiddenwhy #history #newyork #skyscraper
